OpenAI and Anthropic have pledged up to £200 million more in in-kind support: compute and model credits, trusted model access and technical help, not another £200 million in cash. Published overnight UK time, the announcement creates a new National AI Biosecurity Initiative tying Britain’s health-security agencies, its medicines regulator and three frontier AI labs into a single programme. Britain wants to be the first country with a standing institution built specifically for the intersection of artificial intelligence and biological risk.
